datasets.name: Point cloud data of the upper reach of the Jinsha River
datasets.verbatim: The point cloud was generated through space triangulation encryption processing based on the UAV tilt photography products.

datasets.name: Landslide vector boundary
datasets.verbatim: we labeled the point clouds by using the interpreted landslide vector boundary (Fig. 5c).

methods.name: Dynamic graph attention network (DGA-Net)
methods.summary: A deep learning network for point cloud landslide segmentation that combines dynamic graph convolution and an attention readout function. It uses k-NN to build graph structures, shared MLPs to extract edge features, and an attention mechanism to assign adaptive weights to edge features, which are then aggregated into new point features.
methods.verbatim: In this research, we proposed a dynamic graph attention network (DGA-Net) for point cloud landslide segmentation.

availability.author_statement: Stated as 'No data was used for the research described in the article.'

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not linked or publicly available. The custom code for the DGA-Net method is not provided via a repository or persistent link.
